keyFacts.deployment: Docker Compose in deploy/compose.yaml. The Aspire AppHost (run by derekdperez user) hot-rebuilds debug artifacts and restarts services automatically when source changes. Containers run as root.
keyFacts.dockerLogging: Docker logging driver does NOT support 'docker logs' reading. Check /tmp/argus-web.log for web logs (note: may be stale if process restarted into container).
keyFacts.agentServiceScripts: Python scripts in src/Services/Argus.AgentService/scripts/ are copied to output dir via .csproj Content include. Run via python3 with the script path.
keyFacts.noGitRepo: git is NOT initialized in this directory. No commits, no branches.
keyFacts.codexDb: ~/.codex/state_5.sqlite — threads table with columns: id, created_at (UNIX SECONDS), updated_at, model_provider, tokens_used
keyFacts.geminiQuota: /tmp/gemini-client-error-*.json — error.message contains 'reset after Xh Ym Zs' for quota exhaustion
keyFacts.subscriptionRouting: Windows with source='subscription' are excluded from ComputeRoutingScore's exhaustion check so they never block routing
keyFacts.blazorServer: Argus.Web uses Blazor InteractiveServer (not WASM). Circuit exceptions kill the connection. @rendermode InteractiveServerRenderMode(prerender: false) on provider page.
keyFacts.httpClient: ProviderUsage.razor injects HttpClient scoped to NavigationManager.BaseUri. All API calls go through BFF proxy routes in Program.cs /ui/* endpoints.

doNotTouch: deploy/compose.yaml — deployment config, shared across all services
src/Contracts/Argus.Contracts/ — shared DTOs, changing these breaks all services
